name: Kareah
title: Father of Johanan, military leader after the fall of Jerusalem
summary: Kareah was the father of Johanan and Jonathan, who were among the military leaders remaining in Judah after Babylon's destruction of Jerusalem. He is primarily known through his sons' actions concerning Governor Gedaliah's administration and the subsequent flight to Egypt. Kareah is repeatedly mentioned in the book of Jeremiah as the identifier for his son Johanan.

keyEvents.title: Johanan's Warning to Gedaliah
keyEvents.description: Kareah's son Johanan warned Governor Gedaliah that Ishmael, son of Nethaniah, planned to kill him, but Gedaliah did not believe the warning.

keyEvents.title: The Military Leaders Gather at Gedaliah
keyEvents.description: Johanan, son of Kareah, and the other military leaders came to Gedaliah in Mizpah after the fall of Jerusalem to submit to his rule.

keyEvents.title: The Murder of Gedaliah
keyEvents.description: Ishmael son of Nethaniah killed Gedaliah despite warnings from Johanan son of Kareah, which triggered further chaos in Judah.

keyEvents.title: Johanan Pursues Ishmael
keyEvents.description: After the murder of Gedaliah, Johanan son of Kareah gathered all his men and pursued Ishmael, freeing the captives he had taken.

keyEvents.title: Johanan Consults Jeremiah
keyEvents.description: Johanan son of Kareah and the leaders of the people asked the prophet Jeremiah to seek God's will on whether they should remain in Judah or flee to Egypt.

keyEvents.title: Flight to Egypt Against God's Will
keyEvents.description: Despite Jeremiah's warning to stay in the land, Johanan son of Kareah took the entire group with him and fled to Egypt in disobedience to God's word.
